Frontend successfully rebranded with amber/gold accents. AI language detection working correctly for both Hindi→Hinglish and English→English responses.

Search endpoint GET /api/search?q=query returns results from user's chats

AI responds in English when user writes in English
Frontend loads with 'mini malist' branding (not BrutalReply)
Search button in sidebar opens search panel
Typing in search input shows results from past chats
Clicking search result navigates to that chat
Welcome screen shows 'mini malist' heading with amber/gold accents
Chat creation, messaging, and AI responses working
Chat sidebar shows chat history with amber active indicator
NEW button creates new chat
Delete and rename chat functionality working
Mobile menu button properly hidden on desktop
Dark theme with amber/gold accents implemented correctly
All existing CRUD operations (create, list, send, get, rename, delete) working
X-User-ID header validation working
Search results include proper fields (chat_title, content, chat_id, role)
success_percentage: Backend: 100% (14/14 tests passed), Frontend: 100% (all UI flows working)
